fmhyplay.description:
FMHYPlay is a powerful Android streaming browser and native video player designed for phones, tablets, Android TV, Google TV and Fire TV.

**Features:**
- Native ExoPlayer with hardware-accelerated video playback.
- Built-in ad, tracker and pop-up blocking.
- Optional Cloudflare WARP integration.
- IPTV with more than 11,000 public channels.
- Movie, TV series and anime browsing.
- Built-in subtitle support through OpenSubtitles.
- Chromecast and DLNA casting support.
- TV remote and touchscreen navigation.
- Custom streaming website support.
- No account, analytics or telemetry.

Requires Android 8.0 or newer.

Open-source project licensed under MIT.

Official source: https://github.com/fmhyplay/android
